latest_rss.title: New documentary explores Suzhou's Pingjiang Road
latest_rss.summary: A new three-episode documentary, Pingjiang Road Is a River, offering an in-depth look at Suzhou's best-preserved canal street, aired on Thursday in China, showcasing authentic stories of local restoration, conservation and renewal while highlighting Jiangnan culture's living heritage amid a new era. Each 45-minute episode focuses on the 2,500-year-old city's historical district surrounding Pingjiang Road, a roughly 1.6 km lane of whitewashed houses, stone bridges and teahouses in Suzhou's old city northeast quarter in east China.Episode 1, "Inheritance," profiles intangible cultural heritage practitioners on the street. Episode 2, "Old Dwellings," explores the balance between preservation and development through residents, tourists, merchants and community workers. Episode 3, "Nostalgia," focuses on seasonal food traditions and neighborhood warmth.A documentary film about Pingjiang Road will reportedly have a theatrical release in China next month.
